title: The Last Flame
provenance: Reported by WWWcool (highball#99, 2026-09-14): Apple M1 Pro, macOS 14.5, Highball 0.9.12, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r2, DXVK: the menu comes up, pressing Start does nothing. Measured here 2026-09-19 and 2026-09-20 with the free Prologue (Steam 2517810, the same Unity 2021.3 build) on an M1 Pro, macOS 27.0.
notes: Needs the Wine 11 engine x64-crossover26.3-r11 or later (the recipe names it). Two bugs sat behind the report, both in Wine on macOS and both fixed in r11. Start did nothing because the game's save code asks Windows for the last error after a file call and, on macOS, the place Unity's Mono reads it from (%gs:0x68) held a stray pointer instead of the error code, so a missing save file became an IOException that ended the click (Player.log: IOException: Unknown error (0x...)). The menu's 2560x1440 H.264 video, played through Media Foundation and handed to Direct3D 11 as a shared texture, got no shared handle from DXMT on Wine 11 (Got null handle from IDXGIResource::GetSharedHandle) and failed inside the decoder on Wine 10. On r11 both are gone: the run starts on DXMT and on DXVK, and the video plays on DXMT. DXVK draws the board at 20 fps against DXMT's 86 and shows a still behind the menu instead of the video, so use DXMT. On the default Wine 10 engine neither fix exists, but the error path needs the save file to be missing, which is what a first run looks like: with a save already there the game plays on Wine 10 too, measured here on 2026-09-22 (M1 Pro, macOS 27.0, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r5, DXMT, a full session with runs started and no exception in Player.log, the save having arrived through Steam Cloud). So the Wine 11 engine is what a new player needs, and someone whose save already exists may never see the fault.

knownIssues.symptom: Pressing Start or Embark does nothing on a first run; Player.log has IOException: Unknown error (0x...) from System.IO on the save file
knownIssues.cause: measured: Wine on macOS keeps GetLastError in a different thread slot from the one MSVC-built Mono reads, so a missing save file comes back as garbage instead of file-not-found. It takes a missing save, so it hits a first run and not a copy that already has one
knownIssues.fix: Engine x64-crossover26.3-r11 or later (patch 0011 keeps the two in step). On a Wine 10 engine a run started once by any other means leaves a save, and the game then plays there too.

knownIssues.symptom: The menu's background video does not show
knownIssues.cause: measured: the video needs a Direct3D 11 shared texture; Wine 10 fails in the decoder, Wine 11 before r11 got no handle from DXMT, and DXVK cannot share textures at all
knownIssues.fix: Engine r11 or later with DXMT (patch 0010). On DXVK the menu keeps a still image; the game plays anyway.

verified.result: Prologue on DXMT, three launches: menu with its video, Ascension, Embark, hero and relic picks, the Act I map, the first fight (won, 76 fps during it, 86 to 89 fps on the board at 1728x1117), quit through the menu with the save written each time. One launch on DXVK continued a save to the board at 20 fps. Zero exceptions and zero null-handle lines in Player.log across all runs. The full game was not run; the report's build is the same Unity player.
